manifest_row.title: Three questions about the KiwiSaver fossil fuels ban

screening.main_topic: The Government’s decision to exclude fossil fuel investments from default KiwiSaver funds and the financial, definitional, and climate-related questions it raises.
screening.climate_relevance: The article discusses the ban as a response to climate change and the transition to a low-emissions economy, examining fossil fuel investment, emissions, stranded assets, climate risk, shareholder activism, and the possible effects of divestment on emissions reduction.
screening.reason: Climate change and fossil fuel investment are central to the article’s sustained analysis of the policy, including its stated climate rationale and competing views about whether exclusion or investor engagement better supports climate action.
